Subsequently the appellant filed an application and sought for leave to urge other grounds. In that application it was stated that the learned Counsel after ping through certified copy of the plaint found out that the suit, being Title Suit NO. 266 of 1980, was, in fact, filed on 214.1980 in the Conn. of Munsif, 2nd Court, Barisal and Subsequently that suit, on transfer to the Court of Munsif, 1st Court was renumbered as T.S.No. 118 of 1984. In view of this disclosure grounds on which the leave was granted arc not available to the appellant because the suit was filed within time under Art. 120 of the Limitation Act, and that at the time of filing of the suit the Administrative Tribunal Act, 1980 (Act VII of 1981) did not come into operation, as it got the assent of the Acting President only .on 5th June, 1981.
